utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone. Will the Registrar please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. The case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Mr. Popovic, Mr. Beara, Mr. Nikolic, Mr. Miletic, and Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Registry. May I have the appearance beginning with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MACDONALD
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Jonathan Macdonald, Francois Boudreault, on behalf of the Prosecution. And our case manager, Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Learned Counsel. May I have the appearance beginning with the -- may I have the appearance also for the Defence, and can we have the appearance of Mr. Popovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. My name is Mira Tapuskovic. I am co-counsel of Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Learned Counsel. And then the Defence for Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. John Ostojic on behalf of Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Learned Counsel. May we have also for the Defence of Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Jelena Nikolic and Stephane Bourgon representing Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Learned Counsel. May we also appearance for the Defence of Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Natacha Fauveau-Ivanovic together with Nenad Petrusic for General Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Learned Counsel. And finally, may I have the appearance for the Defence of Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DAVIS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. Simon Davis for Vinko Pandurevic this morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Learned Counsel. Before we continue, I would like to confirm that all the Appellants are able to follow the proceedings in a language they understand. Mr. Popovic. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, yes I can follow in the language I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Beara. THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] The same goes for me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: And Mr. Nikolic. THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC: [Interpretation] I am prepared to follow in a language I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: And Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] I can follow in a language I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: And Mr. Pandurevic, finally. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] I have interpretation and I am following.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me begin by providing a very brief summary of recent decisions and orders issued by the Appeals Chamber in this case. One: On 24th May, 2013, the Appeals Chamber issued a public decision denying Radovan Karadzic's immediate access to the designated non-privileged material in the possession of the Office of the Prosecutor. Two: On 18 July, 2013, Judge Robinson, Pre-Appeal Judge, issued a public order relating to Radovan Karadzic's 17 July 2013 motion requesting the rescission of protected measures for Witness Milomir Savcic, instructing the Victim and Witnesses Section of the Tribunal to consult with the witness. And three: On 24th July, 2013, the Appeals Chamber issued a public decision rescinding these protective measures for the Karadzic proceedings. I will now provide a very brief summary of the status of the pending motions before the Appeals Chamber in this case. The Appeals Chamber is currently seized of two motions: One, Mr. Popovic's third, motion pursuant to Rule 115, filed on 15 August, 2011; and two, Mr. Popovic's fourth motion, pursuant to Rule 115, filed on 19 September, 2011. All responses and replies have been received by the Appeals Chamber and the motions remain under consideration by the Chamber. That covers the summary of pending motions. If there are any matters to be raised by counsel, we can do that after I have heard from the Appellants on the status of their health. May I now ask the Appellants whether they wish to raise any concerns regarding their health or the condition of their detention. If I may start with Mr. Popovic. Do you have any issues to raise in this connection? THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have nothing to say. So far everything is good.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Beara. THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] I have nothing to add either. No complaints.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Nikolic. THE APPELLANT NIKOLIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, my health is good. I have no complaints concerning the conditions of my detention.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Mr. President, given my age and the conditions, things are fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you. And finally, Mr. Pandurevic. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the conditions are good. My health is good. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you very much all for your observation on this matter. May I now ask whether there are any additional matters to be raised by the Prosecution or any of the counsel? Learned Counsel for the Prosecution, do you have any issue?

utterances.speaker: MR. MACDONALD
utterances.text: The Prosecution doesn't wish to raise any issues at this time, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE SEKULE
utterances.text: Thank you, Learned Counsel. And members of the Defence, do you have any issues to raise at this juncture? None. Thank you. Well, then, there being no other matters to be raised, this Status Conference is hereby adjourned.
